digest.component_or_area: pytest test harness / temporary file management
propositions: nested pytest children launched without explicit --basetemp join the user-global numbered root and may delete unrelated cleanup-eligible directories at session finish

tests/unit/test_engine_dir.py and tests/unit/test_scripts_import_convention.py execute nested pytest without passing tmp_path-derived --basetemp, allowing unowned children to allocate and clean up the shared numbered root
parent pytest processes must own the temporary lifetime by passing unique basetemp paths to each nested child to prevent cross-session pollution
pytest 9.1.1 TempPathFactory.getbasetemp creates and registers cleanup for the numbered root, and pytest_sessionfinish executes that cleanup unless _basetemp remains None
the repair assigns tmp_path/mixed-module-pytest and tmp_path/standalone-pytest as --basetemp to the respective nested children and asserts directory materialization
